تنتظري (form VIII)
# تَنْتَظِرِي (tantaẓirī) /tan.ta.ðˤi.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَظَرَ (intaẓara)
# تُنْتَظَرِي (tuntaẓarī) /tun.ta.ðˤa.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَظَرَ (intaẓara)
